name.en: Injuries keep lowering your abilities after you load a save
name.ja: セーブを読み込んだ後も怪我が能力値に効き続ける

description.en: An injured body part lowers your abilities, but after loading a save the game rebuilds them without the injuries, so they are back to full until the next injury check during a quest. The abilities are now rebuilt once more right after loading, with the injuries applied.
description.ja: 怪我をした部位は能力値を下げるが、セーブを読み込むとゲームは怪我を掛けずに能力値を作り直すので、依頼で次の怪我の判定が走るまで能力値が元の値に戻っていた。読み込みの直後に、怪我を掛けた能力値へ組み直す。
